bullets.title: Offer Ranking Plugin
bullets.text: Built a pre-ranking plugin within the offer-ranking system, serving 1B+ requests daily, that calls an index API to detect items co-shippable with a customer's cart and augments the offer with an incentive amount; targeted a 2–3% unit-share uplift and multi-million-dollar annual shipping-cost savings across 8 international marketplaces.

bullets.title: Horizontal Multi Offer Display
bullets.text: End-to-end implementation of the "Pair and Save" feature swatch for the Multi Offer Display in the Amazon Shopping Experience on mobile and desktop, live in 4 worldwide marketplaces.

bullets.title: Infrastructure Teardown
bullets.text: Verified zero production traffic across metrics and logs over a 2+ week window, then tore down the deprecated region end-to-end (CDK stacks, load-balancer relay configs, certificates, pipeline stages), eliminating a full regional fleet and its recurring operational cost.

bullets.title: Data Reconciliation
bullets.text: Shipped a reconciliation Lambda and a reusable Java library comparing source and destination records for data-replication workflows, with CloudWatch metrics tracking success rate, processed and failure counts.

bullets.title: AI On-Call Analyzer
bullets.text: Built an AI-native on-call analyzer that ingests tickets, logs and runbooks to auto-generate triage summaries and root-cause suggestions, cutting mean time to diagnose by 20% and easing on-call load.

bullets.title: Steady-State Validation
bullets.text: Designed and implemented a CloudWatch-based steady-state validator for data-replication workflows, orchestrating composite alarm checks and metric-threshold validations via AWS Step Functions.

bullets.title: Performance Assessment Tool
bullets.text: Engineered the Feedback module using React and AWS Lambda, enabling performance tracking for 200+ employees.

bullets.title: PAT Migration
bullets.text: Migrated the performance-assessment platform from an always-on to a fully serverless AWS architecture, cutting infrastructure cost by 90% while holding scalability through peak review cycles.

bullets.title: Workflow Optimization
bullets.text: Restructured and optimized a ColdFusion-based recursive workflow, reducing message delivery time from 120+ minutes to under 35 minutes (70% improvement).

bullets.title: Mentorship
bullets.text: Mentored 2 SDE interns, providing design guidance and code reviews that helped them ship their internship project on schedule.

bullets.title: Observability
bullets.text: Improved application observability by creating 5+ Datadog dashboards for backend APIs and complete GCP performance monitoring.

bullets.title: Test Automation
bullets.text: Developed a Cypress-based automated framework for validating content, delivery triggers and backend API responses, reducing manual QA cycles and ensuring reliable communication for 50,000+ students.

bullets.title: Internet Booking Engine
bullets.text: Collaborated with a team of developers to build and deploy a scalable Internet Booking Engine using React.js, Spring Boot and AWS services.

bullets.title: Membership Platform
bullets.text: Developed the Email Blasting and File Upload & Preview modules for the membership platform, improving operational efficiency by 30%.

bullets.title: Search Functionality
bullets.text: Designed a popup menu with search, reducing search time by 45% for users navigating the membership system.
